//: shinobi, fire nature.  Looks and talks exactly like the others.

dialogue.offer: Bring me a training scroll so that I may become stronger, I must defend my village.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't need your help anyways...
dialogue.advice: They are often located in towers infested with devils.
dialogue.success_lie: No worries, I've been training here on my own anyways
dialogue.failure: No worries, I've been training here on my own anyways

dialogue.describe: You seem to be a powerful shinobi...
dialogue.offer: A member of my ninja squad arrived in this area for reinforcements, go and find them and bring them to me, we should make a strong team together
dialogue.accepted: Alright, if they don't show then you are free to bring any shinobi you find sufficient as a squad member, just be sure to choose wisely.
dialogue.rejected: I see you aren't the shinobi I thought you were.
dialogue.advice: I am unfamiliar with these strange lands, and on edge. My shinobi squadmate may be as well
dialogue.inquire: Have you rendezvoused with my partner yet?
dialogue.success: Great, now our chances of survival have increased greatly.

description: A syringe filled with powerful stimulants that can be injected to heal yourself
